summary: TTEC Holdings, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting results of its 2026 Annual Meeting and a re-domestication from Delaware to Texas. Stockholders approved director elections, ratification of auditor, advisory say-on-pay, and the re-domestication plan. The re-domestication became effective May 22, 2026 via filings with Delaware and Texas. No special situation event; the filing discloses routine corporate governance matters and a change of domicile. No deal terms, activist campaign, or strategic review present.
